headline: CF-0002 LTV is 69.41% vs a 70.0% margin-call trigger (0.6 pts of headroom)

evidence.rm_note: Accumulator settlements are running against the client. Drew a further HKD 4m on the facility to meet obligations. Client remains convinced the Hong Kong property market turns this year. I pointed out that the perpetual, the shares, the accumulator and his own development business are all the same bet. He said that is why he is confident.

suggested_action: Walk the LTV trajectory with the client; agree a plan before collateral volatility forces the bank's hand.
